name: Ruth
overview: The book of Ruth opens during a time of famine, where Elimelech and his family sojourn in Moab, setting the stage for the unfolding story of loyalty and divine providence. Naomi, after the loss of her husband and sons, decides to return to Judah upon hearing that the LORD has provided bread for His people. She urges her daughters-in-law to return to their own homes, but Ruth's steadfast devotion to Naomi highlights a profound commitment that transcends circumstance. These opening verses emphasize God's faithfulness in providing for His people and introduce the faithful relationship between Ruth and Naomi.
